contradictions.a: ἢν δ' ἄρα ἐμβεβλημένῳ σπασμὸς ἐπιγένηται, ἐμβάλλειν τὸ ἄρθρον δεῖ ταχύ.
contradictions.b: ēn de spasmos epigenētai tōi katatetagmenōi, chre tacheōs ekballein to arthron.
contradictions.why: A says to reduce (re-set) the joint if a spasm occurs; B says to 'throw out' (dislocate) the joint.
